title: Masterclass on LinkedIn Sales Outreach
cardDescription:
Zero Point Five’s LinkedIn Sales Outreach Masterclass with Tejas Jhaveri. Learn how to book 200+ meetings/month, craft outreach that converts & scale your GTM.

28 Nov | 12–1 PM IST | Online
description:
A hands-on session for founders who need meetings on the calendar, not theory.

What you will learn

A hands-on approach to booking over 200 meetings a month and building out your GTM capability
Which channels to use in your GTM
How to polish your LinkedIn profile and optimise it for the platform
How to write the right messages, and use pattern-disrupting moments to get attention and book meetings
What the funnel looks like for LinkedIn and for cold email
Practical tips to get better at outreach and drive more revenue

Who this is for
Works for domestic and international outreach.
1.
Heading: Founders and B2B businesses
Text: Entrepreneurs, B2B businesses and CXOs who want a steady flow of conversations.

Heading: Marketing teams
Text: Marketing departments building a LinkedIn and cold email outreach engine.

Heading: Anyone learning outreach
Text: Students, employees and business owners curious about cold outreach.
